note: Redeployed for partial-fill matchOrders support: place_order/cancel_order/match_orders circuits rewritten onto the owner_key(spending_key) order-ownership scheme, match_orders now proves real fill amounts with optional residual-order outputs instead of an exact-bilateral-cross-only match. A first version of this redeploy used a 64-bit range-check bound on amounts (assert_64) that turned out too tight for 18-decimal WFLR amounts (a plain 50 WFLR order already exceeds 2^64 raw units) — caught by a real end-to-end test, not a unit test with toy numbers; fixed by switching to a 100-bit bound (assert_100), safe because Noir's u128 multiplication is itself overflow-checked (confirmed empirically), not silently wrapping. Poseidon2/WithdrawVerifier/PayVerifier/ComplianceRegistry/StealthAnnouncer/OwnerKeyRegistry are unchanged and reused from the prior deployment (targeted redeploy — see contract/scripts/redeploy-vault-only.ts) so existing OwnerKeyRegistry registrations weren't orphaned. Earlier addresses in this file's history are stale.
